dublin_boutique_keeper.text: Well now, how are you? Grafton Street has buskers and the prices have opinions. Take your time.

then.text: That {worn_coat} is class. Yer man at the door will think you own the place.
A grand {worn_hat}. You'd get a nod off any publican in the country.
That {worn_top} is lovely, so it is.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Ah, you're dressed very plain. Not a bother. We'll sort you out.

dublin_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
